verses.display_text: For the promise to Abraham or to his seed that he would be heir of the world was not through law, but through the righteousness of faith.

verses.text: For if those from law are heirs, faith has been emptied and the promise has been nullified;
verses.display_text: For if those from law are heirs, faith has been emptied and the promise has been nullified;

verses.text: for the law brings wrath, but where there is no law, neither is there transgression.
verses.display_text: for the law brings wrath, but where there is no law, neither is there transgression.

verses.text: For this reason it is from faith, so that it may be according to grace, so that the promise may be secure to all the seed—not only to the one from the law, but also to the one from Abraham’s faith. He is father of us all,
verses.display_text: For this reason it is from faith, so that it may be according to grace, so that the promise may be secure to all the seed—not only to the one from the law, but also to the one from Abraham’s faith. He is father of us all,

verses.text: just as it is written, “I have made you father of many nations,” before the God whom he believed, who gives life to the dead and calls the things that are not as though they are.
verses.display_text: just as it is written, “I have made you father of many nations,” before the God whom he believed, who gives life to the dead and calls the things that are not as though they are.

verses.text: Against hope, he believed in hope, so that he might become father of many nations, according to what had been said, “So shall your seed be.”
verses.display_text: Against hope, he believed in hope, so that he might become father of many nations, according to what had been said, “So shall your seed be.”

verses.text: And without growing weak in faith, he considered his own body, already deadened as it was, being about a hundred years old, and the deadness of Sarah’s womb;
verses.display_text: And without growing weak in faith, he considered his own body, already deadened as it was, being about a hundred years old, and the deadness of Sarah’s womb;

verses.text: but with regard to God’s promise he did not waver in unbelief, but was strengthened in faith, giving glory to God,
verses.display_text: but with regard to God’s promise he did not waver in unbelief, but was strengthened in faith, giving glory to God,

verses.text: and being fully assured that what He has promised He is also able to do.
verses.display_text: and being fully assured that what He has promised He is also able to do.

verses.text: Therefore it was also reckoned to him as righteousness.
verses.display_text: Therefore it was also reckoned to him as righteousness.

verses.text: But “it was reckoned to him” was not written for his sake alone,
verses.display_text: But “it was reckoned to him” was not written for his sake alone,

verses.text: but also for our sake, to whom it is to be reckoned, who believe in the One who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,
verses.display_text: but also for our sake, to whom it is to be reckoned, who believe in the One who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,

verses.text: who was handed over for our trespasses and was raised for our justification.
verses.display_text: who was handed over for our trespasses and was raised for our justification.

verses.text: Therefore, having been justified from faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.display_text: Therefore, having been justified from faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.text: through whom we have also obtained access by faith into this grace in which we stand; and we boast in hope of God’s glory.
verses.display_text: through whom we have also obtained access by faith into this grace in which we stand; and we boast in hope of God’s glory.

verses.text: And not only this, but we also boast in afflictions, knowing that affliction produces perseverance,
verses.display_text: And not only this, but we also boast in afflictions, knowing that affliction produces perseverance,

verses.text: and perseverance, proven character, and proven character, hope.
verses.display_text: and perseverance, proven character, and proven character, hope.

verses.text: And hope does not put us to shame, because God’s love has been poured out in our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
verses.display_text: And hope does not put us to shame, because God’s love has been poured out in our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

verses.text: For while we were still weak, even then Christ died at the appointed time for the ungodly.
verses.display_text: For while we were still weak, even then Christ died at the appointed time for the ungodly.

verses.text: For rarely will someone die for a righteous person; though perhaps for the good person someone even dares to die.
verses.display_text: For rarely will someone die for a righteous person; though perhaps for the good person someone even dares to die.

verses.text: But God demonstrates His own love toward us in that, while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.display_text: But God demonstrates His own love toward us in that, while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

verses.text: Much more, then, having now been justified in His blood, we will be saved through Him from wrath.
verses.display_text: Much more, then, having now been justified in His blood, we will be saved through Him from wrath.

verses.text: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of His Son, much more, having been reconciled, we will be saved in His life.
verses.display_text: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of His Son, much more, having been reconciled, we will be saved in His life.

verses.text: And not only this, but we also boast in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation.
verses.display_text: And not only this, but we also boast in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation.

verses.text: For this reason, just as through one person sin entered the world, and through sin, death, and so death passed to all people, because all sinned—
verses.display_text: For this reason, just as through one person sin entered the world, and through sin, death, and so death passed to all people, because all sinned—

verses.text: for before the law came, sin was in the world, but sin is not charged to account when there is no law;
verses.display_text: for before the law came, sin was in the world, but sin is not charged to account when there is no law;

verses.text: nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those who did not sin in the likeness of Adam’s transgression, who is a type of the One to come.
verses.display_text: nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those who did not sin in the likeness of Adam’s transgression, who is a type of the One to come.

verses.text: But the gift is not like the trespass. For if by the one man’s trespass the many died, much more did God’s grace and the gift in the grace of the one Man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.
verses.display_text: But the gift is not like the trespass. For if by the one man’s trespass the many died, much more did God’s grace and the gift in the grace of the one Man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

verses.text: And the gift is not like what came through one who sinned; for the judgment from one trespass resulted in condemnation, but the gift from many trespasses resulted in justification.
verses.display_text: And the gift is not like what came through one who sinned; for the judgment from one trespass resulted in condemnation, but the gift from many trespasses resulted in justification.

verses.text: For if, by the one man’s trespass, death reigned through the one, much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and the gift of righteousness reign in life through the One, Jesus Christ.
verses.display_text: For if, by the one man’s trespass, death reigned through the one, much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and the gift of righteousness reign in life through the One, Jesus Christ.

verses.text: So then, as through one trespass there was condemnation for all people, so also through one righteous act there is justification of life for all people.
verses.display_text: So then, as through one trespass there was condemnation for all people, so also through one righteous act there is justification of life for all people.

verses.text: For just as through the disobedience of the one person the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the One the many will be made righteous.
verses.display_text: For just as through the disobedience of the one person the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the One the many will be made righteous.

verses.text: But law came in alongside, so that the trespass might increase; but where sin increased, grace abounded beyond measure,
verses.display_text: But law came in alongside, so that the trespass might increase; but where sin increased, grace abounded beyond measure,

verses.text: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness for eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.display_text: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness for eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.text: What, then, shall we say? Should we remain in sin so that grace may increase?
verses.display_text: What, then, shall we say? Should we remain in sin so that grace may increase?

verses.text: May it never be! We who died to sin, how will we still live in it?
verses.display_text: May it never be! We who died to sin, how will we still live in it?

verses.text: Or do you not know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into His death?
verses.display_text: Or do you not know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into His death?

verses.text: Therefore we were buried with Him through baptism into death, so that, just as Christ was raised from the dead through the Father’s glory, so we also might walk in newness of life.
verses.display_text: Therefore we were buried with Him through baptism into death, so that, just as Christ was raised from the dead through the Father’s glory, so we also might walk in newness of life.

verses.text: For if we have become united with the likeness of His death, we will also be united with that of His resurrection,
verses.display_text: For if we have become united with the likeness of His death, we will also be united with that of His resurrection,

verses.text: knowing this, that our old self was crucified with Him, so that the body of sin might be rendered powerless, so that we would no longer be enslaved to sin;
verses.display_text: knowing this, that our old self was crucified with Him, so that the body of sin might be rendered powerless, so that we would no longer be enslaved to sin;

verses.text: for the one who died has been justified from sin.
verses.display_text: for the one who died has been justified from sin.

verses.text: And if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with Him,
verses.display_text: And if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with Him,

verses.text: knowing that Christ, having been raised from the dead, no longer dies; death no longer rules over Him.
verses.display_text: knowing that Christ, having been raised from the dead, no longer dies; death no longer rules over Him.

verses.text: For the death He died, He died to sin once for all; but the life He lives, He lives to God.
verses.display_text: For the death He died, He died to sin once for all; but the life He lives, He lives to God.

verses.text: So also reckon yourselves to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus.
verses.display_text: So also reckon yourselves to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus.

verses.text: Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body, so that you obey its desires;
verses.display_text: Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body, so that you obey its desires;

verses.text: Do not present the parts of your body to sin as weapons of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as those alive from the dead, and the parts of your body to God as weapons of righteousness.
verses.display_text: Do not present the parts of your body to sin as weapons of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as those alive from the dead, and the parts of your body to God as weapons of righteousness.

verses.text: For sin will not rule over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.
verses.display_text: For sin will not rule over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.

verses.text: What, then? Should we sin because we are not under law, but under grace? May it never be!
verses.display_text: What, then? Should we sin because we are not under law, but under grace? May it never be!

verses.text: Do you not know that when you present yourselves to someone as slaves to obey, you are slaves of the one whom you obey, either of sin leading to death, or of obedience leading to righteousness?
verses.display_text: Do you not know that when you present yourselves to someone as slaves to obey, you are slaves of the one whom you obey, either of sin leading to death, or of obedience leading to righteousness?

verses.text: But thanks be to God that, though you were slaves of sin, you obeyed from the heart the pattern of teaching to which you were handed over;
verses.display_text: But thanks be to God that, though you were slaves of sin, you obeyed from the heart the pattern of teaching to which you were handed over;

verses.text: and, having been set free from sin, you were enslaved to righteousness.
verses.display_text: and, having been set free from sin, you were enslaved to righteousness.

verses.text: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh. For just as you presented the parts of your body as slaves to impurity and to lawlessness leading to lawlessness, so now present the parts of your body as slaves to righteousness leading to sanctification.
verses.display_text: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh. For just as you presented the parts of your body as slaves to impurity and to lawlessness leading to lawlessness, so now present the parts of your body as slaves to righteousness leading to sanctification.

verses.text: For when you were slaves of sin, you were free from righteousness.
verses.display_text: For when you were slaves of sin, you were free from righteousness.

verses.text: What fruit, then, did you have at that time from the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
verses.display_text: What fruit, then, did you have at that time from the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

verses.text: But now, having been set free from sin and enslaved to God, you have your fruit leading to sanctification, and the end, eternal life.
verses.display_text: But now, having been set free from sin and enslaved to God, you have your fruit leading to sanctification, and the end, eternal life.

verses.text: For sin’s wages are death, but God’s gift is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.display_text: For sin’s wages are death, but God’s gift is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.text: Or do you not know, brothers—for I speak to those who know law—that the law rules over a person for as long as he lives?
verses.display_text: Or do you not know, brothers—for I speak to those who know law—that the law rules over a person for as long as he lives?

verses.text: For the married woman is bound by law to her living husband; but if the husband dies, she has been released from the law of the husband.
verses.display_text: For the married woman is bound by law to her living husband; but if the husband dies, she has been released from the law of the husband.

verses.text: So then, while the husband lives, she will be called an adulteress if she belongs to another man; but if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is not an adulteress when she belongs to another man.
verses.display_text: So then, while the husband lives, she will be called an adulteress if she belongs to another man; but if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is not an adulteress when she belongs to another man.

verses.text: So, my brothers, you also were put to death to the law through the body of Christ, so that you might belong to Another, the One raised from the dead, so that we might bear fruit for God.
verses.display_text: So, my brothers, you also were put to death to the law through the body of Christ, so that you might belong to Another, the One raised from the dead, so that we might bear fruit for God.

verses.text: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions aroused through the law were at work in the parts of our body, to bear fruit for death.
verses.display_text: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions aroused through the law were at work in the parts of our body, to bear fruit for death.

verses.text: But now we were released from the law, having died to that in which we were held, so that we serve in the newness of the Spirit and not in the oldness of the letter.
verses.display_text: But now we were released from the law, having died to that in which we were held, so that we serve in the newness of the Spirit and not in the oldness of the letter.

verses.text: What, then, shall we say? Is the law sin? May it never be! Rather, I did not know sin except through law; for I would not have known desire if the law had not said, “You shall not desire.”
verses.display_text: What, then, shall we say? Is the law sin? May it never be! Rather, I did not know sin except through law; for I would not have known desire if the law had not said, “You shall not desire.”

verses.text: But sin, taking opportunity through the commandment, produced every desire in me; for apart from law sin is dead.
verses.display_text: But sin, taking opportunity through the commandment, produced every desire in me; for apart from law sin is dead.

verses.text: And I was once alive apart from law; but when the commandment came, sin came to life,
verses.display_text: And I was once alive apart from law; but when the commandment came, sin came to life,

verses.text: and I died; and the commandment that was for life proved to bring me death.
verses.display_text: and I died; and the commandment that was for life proved to bring me death.

verses.text: For sin, taking opportunity through the commandment, deceived me and through it killed me.
verses.display_text: For sin, taking opportunity through the commandment, deceived me and through it killed me.

verses.text: So the law is holy, and the commandment holy and righteous and good.
verses.display_text: So the law is holy, and the commandment holy and righteous and good.

verses.text: Did the good, then, become death to me? May it never be! But sin did, so that it might appear as sin, producing death in me through the good, so that through the commandment sin might become sinful beyond measure.
verses.display_text: Did the good, then, become death to me? May it never be! But sin did, so that it might appear as sin, producing death in me through the good, so that through the commandment sin might become sinful beyond measure.

verses.text: For we know that the law is spiritual; but I am of flesh, sold under sin.
verses.display_text: For we know that the law is spiritual; but I am of flesh, sold under sin.

verses.text: For I do not understand what I do; for I do not practice what I want, but what I hate, this I do.
verses.display_text: For I do not understand what I do; for I do not practice what I want, but what I hate, this I do.

verses.text: But if I do what I do not want, I agree with the law that it is good.
verses.display_text: But if I do what I do not want, I agree with the law that it is good.

verses.text: But now it is no longer I who do it, but sin dwelling in me.
verses.display_text: But now it is no longer I who do it, but sin dwelling in me.

verses.text: For I know that good does not dwell in me—that is, in my flesh. For the will is there, but doing what is good is not.
verses.display_text: For I know that good does not dwell in me—that is, in my flesh. For the will is there, but doing what is good is not.

verses.text: For I do not do the good that I want, but the evil that I do not want, this I practice.
verses.display_text: For I do not do the good that I want, but the evil that I do not want, this I practice.

verses.text: But if I do what I do not want, it is no longer I who do it, but sin dwelling in me.
verses.display_text: But if I do what I do not want, it is no longer I who do it, but sin dwelling in me.

verses.text: So I find this law: when I want to do the good, evil is at hand for me.
verses.display_text: So I find this law: when I want to do the good, evil is at hand for me.

verses.text: For I delight in God’s law in my inner self,
verses.display_text: For I delight in God’s law in my inner self,

verses.text: but I see another law in the parts of my body, waging war against the law of my mind and taking me captive in the law of sin that is in the parts of my body.
verses.display_text: but I see another law in the parts of my body, waging war against the law of my mind and taking me captive in the law of sin that is in the parts of my body.

verses.text: Wretched person that I am! Who will rescue me from the body of this death?
verses.display_text: Wretched person that I am! Who will rescue me from the body of this death?

verses.text: Thanks be to God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then I myself, with the mind, serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.
verses.display_text: Thanks be to God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then I myself, with the mind, serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.

verses.text: So then, there is now no condemnation for those in Christ Jesus.
verses.display_text: So then, there is now no condemnation for those in Christ Jesus.

verses.text: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus set you free from the law of sin and death.
verses.display_text: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus set you free from the law of sin and death.

verses.text: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did: sending His own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and concerning sin, He condemned sin in the flesh,
verses.display_text: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did: sending His own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and concerning sin, He condemned sin in the flesh,

verses.text: so that the law’s righteous requirement might be fulfilled in us who walk not according to flesh, but according to Spirit.
verses.display_text: so that the law’s righteous requirement might be fulfilled in us who walk not according to flesh, but according to Spirit.

verses.text: For those who are according to flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those according to Spirit, on the things of the Spirit.
verses.display_text: For those who are according to flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those according to Spirit, on the things of the Spirit.

verses.text: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace,
verses.display_text: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace,

verses.text: because the mind of the flesh is hostility toward God; for it does not submit to God’s law, nor indeed can it.
verses.display_text: because the mind of the flesh is hostility toward God; for it does not submit to God’s law, nor indeed can it.

verses.text: And those who are in flesh cannot please God.
verses.display_text: And those who are in flesh cannot please God.

verses.text: But you are not in flesh, but in Spirit, if indeed God’s Spirit dwells in you. But if anyone does not have Christ’s Spirit, that person does not belong to Him.
verses.display_text: But you are not in flesh, but in Spirit, if indeed God’s Spirit dwells in you. But if anyone does not have Christ’s Spirit, that person does not belong to Him.

verses.text: But if Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
verses.display_text: But if Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.

verses.text: And if the Spirit of the One who raised Jesus from the dead dwells in you, the One who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit dwelling in you.
verses.display_text: And if the Spirit of the One who raised Jesus from the dead dwells in you, the One who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit dwelling in you.

verses.text: So then, brothers, we are debtors—not to the flesh, to live according to flesh;
verses.display_text: So then, brothers, we are debtors—not to the flesh, to live according to flesh;

verses.text: for if you live according to flesh, you are going to die; but if by Spirit you put to death the body’s practices, you will live.
verses.display_text: for if you live according to flesh, you are going to die; but if by Spirit you put to death the body’s practices, you will live.

verses.text: For all who are led by God’s Spirit are sons of God.
verses.display_text: For all who are led by God’s Spirit are sons of God.

verses.text: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery leading again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption as sons, in whom we cry, “Abba, Father.”
verses.display_text: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery leading again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption as sons, in whom we cry, “Abba, Father.”

verses.text: The Spirit Himself bears witness with our spirit that we are God’s children.
verses.display_text: The Spirit Himself bears witness with our spirit that we are God’s children.

verses.text: And if children, then also heirs: heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with Him so that we may also be glorified with Him.
verses.display_text: And if children, then also heirs: heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with Him so that we may also be glorified with Him.

verses.text: For I reckon that the sufferings of the present time are not worth comparing with the glory that is to be revealed in us.
verses.display_text: For I reckon that the sufferings of the present time are not worth comparing with the glory that is to be revealed in us.

verses.text: For creation eagerly awaits the revealing of God’s sons;
verses.display_text: For creation eagerly awaits the revealing of God’s sons;

verses.text: for creation was subjected to futility, not willingly, but because of the One who subjected it, in hope
verses.display_text: for creation was subjected to futility, not willingly, but because of the One who subjected it, in hope

verses.text: that creation itself also will be set free from slavery to corruption into the freedom of the glory of God’s children.
verses.display_text: that creation itself also will be set free from slavery to corruption into the freedom of the glory of God’s children.

verses.text: For we know that the whole creation groans together and labors in birth pangs together until now;
verses.display_text: For we know that the whole creation groans together and labors in birth pangs together until now;

verses.text: and not only creation, but we ourselves also, having the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan within ourselves, awaiting adoption as sons, the redemption of our body.
verses.display_text: and not only creation, but we ourselves also, having the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan within ourselves, awaiting adoption as sons, the redemption of our body.

verses.text: For in hope we were saved. But hope that is seen is not hope; for who hopes for what he sees?
verses.display_text: For in hope we were saved. But hope that is seen is not hope; for who hopes for what he sees?

verses.text: But if we hope for what we do not see, we await it with perseverance.
verses.display_text: But if we hope for what we do not see, we await it with perseverance.

verses.text: And likewise the Spirit also helps our weakness; for we do not know what to pray for as we ought, but the Spirit Himself intercedes with groanings beyond words.
verses.display_text: And likewise the Spirit also helps our weakness; for we do not know what to pray for as we ought, but the Spirit Himself intercedes with groanings beyond words.

verses.text: And the One who searches hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because He intercedes for saints according to God.
verses.display_text: And the One who searches hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because He intercedes for saints according to God.

verses.text: And we know that all things work together for good for those who love God, those who are called according to purpose.
verses.display_text: And we know that all things work together for good for those who love God, those who are called according to purpose.

verses.text: Because those whom He foreknew, He also predestined to be conformed to the image of His Son, so that He might be firstborn among many brothers;
verses.display_text: Because those whom He foreknew, He also predestined to be conformed to the image of His Son, so that He might be firstborn among many brothers;

verses.text: and those whom He predestined, these He also called; and those whom He called, these He also justified; and those whom He justified, these He also glorified.
verses.display_text: and those whom He predestined, these He also called; and those whom He called, these He also justified; and those whom He justified, these He also glorified.

verses.text: What, then, shall we say to these things? If God is for us, who is against us?
verses.display_text: What, then, shall we say to these things? If God is for us, who is against us?

verses.text: He who did not spare His own Son, but handed Him over for us all, how will He not also graciously give us all things with Him?
verses.display_text: He who did not spare His own Son, but handed Him over for us all, how will He not also graciously give us all things with Him?

verses.text: for it is God’s servant to you for good. But if you do evil, be afraid; for it does not bear the sword without purpose. For it is God’s servant, an avenger who brings wrath on the one who practices evil.
verses.display_text: for it is God’s servant to you for good. But if you do evil, be afraid; for it does not bear the sword without purpose. For it is God’s servant, an avenger who brings wrath on the one who practices evil.

verses.text: Therefore it is necessary to submit, not only because of wrath, but also because of conscience.
verses.display_text: Therefore it is necessary to submit, not only because of wrath, but also because of conscience.

verses.text: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are God’s ministers, devoted to this very task.
verses.display_text: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are God’s ministers, devoted to this very task.

verses.text: Pay everyone what is owed: tax to whom tax is due, duty to whom duty is due, fear to whom fear is due, honor to whom honor is due.
verses.display_text: Pay everyone what is owed: tax to whom tax is due, duty to whom duty is due, fear to whom fear is due, honor to whom honor is due.

verses.text: Owe no one anything except to love one another; for the one who loves the other has fulfilled law.
verses.display_text: Owe no one anything except to love one another; for the one who loves the other has fulfilled law.

verses.text: For “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not desire,” and if there is any other commandment, it is summed up in this word: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
verses.display_text: For “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not desire,” and if there is any other commandment, it is summed up in this word: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

verses.text: Love does no evil to the neighbor; therefore love is the fulfillment of law.
verses.display_text: Love does no evil to the neighbor; therefore love is the fulfillment of law.

verses.text: And do this knowing the time, that it is already the hour for you to rise from sleep; for now salvation is nearer to us than when we believed.
verses.display_text: And do this knowing the time, that it is already the hour for you to rise from sleep; for now salvation is nearer to us than when we believed.

verses.text: The night has advanced, and the day has drawn near. Therefore let us put away the works of darkness and put on the weapons of light.
verses.display_text: The night has advanced, and the day has drawn near. Therefore let us put away the works of darkness and put on the weapons of light.

verses.text: Let us walk honorably as in daytime, not in revelries and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and licentiousness, not in strife and jealousy;
verses.display_text: Let us walk honorably as in daytime, not in revelries and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and licentiousness, not in strife and jealousy;

verses.text: but put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and do not make provision for the flesh to satisfy its desires.
verses.display_text: but put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and do not make provision for the flesh to satisfy its desires.

verses.text: Welcome the one who is weak in faith, but not to dispute over opinions.
verses.display_text: Welcome the one who is weak in faith, but not to dispute over opinions.

verses.text: One believes he may eat all things, but the weak person eats vegetables.
verses.display_text: One believes he may eat all things, but the weak person eats vegetables.

verses.text: Do not let the one who eats despise the one who does not eat; and do not let the one who does not eat judge the one who eats, for God welcomed him.
verses.display_text: Do not let the one who eats despise the one who does not eat; and do not let the one who does not eat judge the one who eats, for God welcomed him.

verses.text: Who are you to judge another’s household slave? To his own master he stands or falls; and he will be made to stand, for the Lord is able to make him stand.
verses.display_text: Who are you to judge another’s household slave? To his own master he stands or falls; and he will be made to stand, for the Lord is able to make him stand.

verses.text: For one judges one day above another, but another judges every day alike. Let each be fully assured in his own mind.
verses.display_text: For one judges one day above another, but another judges every day alike. Let each be fully assured in his own mind.

verses.text: The one who regards the day regards it for the Lord. And the one who eats eats for the Lord, for he gives thanks to God; and the one who does not eat refrains for the Lord and gives thanks to God.
verses.display_text: The one who regards the day regards it for the Lord. And the one who eats eats for the Lord, for he gives thanks to God; and the one who does not eat refrains for the Lord and gives thanks to God.

verses.text: For none of us lives for himself, and none dies for himself;
verses.display_text: For none of us lives for himself, and none dies for himself;

verses.text: for if we live, we live for the Lord, and if we die, we die for the Lord. So whether we live or die, we are the Lord’s.
verses.display_text: for if we live, we live for the Lord, and if we die, we die for the Lord. So whether we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

verses.text: For to this end Christ died and lived, so that He might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
verses.display_text: For to this end Christ died and lived, so that He might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

verses.text: But why do you judge your brother? Or you also, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before God’s judgment seat,
verses.display_text: But why do you judge your brother? Or you also, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before God’s judgment seat,

verses.text: for it is written, “As I live, says the Lord, every knee will bend to Me, and every tongue will confess to God.”
verses.display_text: for it is written, “As I live, says the Lord, every knee will bend to Me, and every tongue will confess to God.”

verses.text: So then, each of us will give an account of himself to God.
verses.display_text: So then, each of us will give an account of himself to God.

verses.text: Therefore let us no longer judge one another; but judge this instead: not to place a stumbling block or a snare for a brother.
verses.display_text: Therefore let us no longer judge one another; but judge this instead: not to place a stumbling block or a snare for a brother.

verses.text: I know and am convinced in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself; except that to the one who reckons something unclean, to that person it is unclean.
verses.display_text: I know and am convinced in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself; except that to the one who reckons something unclean, to that person it is unclean.

verses.text: For if your brother is grieved because of food, you no longer walk according to love. Do not destroy with your food the one for whom Christ died.
verses.display_text: For if your brother is grieved because of food, you no longer walk according to love. Do not destroy with your food the one for whom Christ died.

verses.text: Therefore do not let your good be spoken of as evil.
verses.display_text: Therefore do not let your good be spoken of as evil.

verses.text: For God’s kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit;
verses.display_text: For God’s kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit;

verses.text: for the one who serves Christ in this is pleasing to God and approved by people.
verses.display_text: for the one who serves Christ in this is pleasing to God and approved by people.

verses.text: So then, let us pursue what makes for peace and what builds up one another.
verses.display_text: So then, let us pursue what makes for peace and what builds up one another.

verses.text: Do not tear down God’s work for the sake of food. All things indeed are clean, but it is evil for a person to eat in a way that causes stumbling.
verses.display_text: Do not tear down God’s work for the sake of food. All things indeed are clean, but it is evil for a person to eat in a way that causes stumbling.

verses.text: It is good not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything by which your brother stumbles.
verses.display_text: It is good not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything by which your brother stumbles.

verses.text: The faith you have, keep to yourself before God. Blessed is the one who does not judge himself in what he approves.
verses.display_text: The faith you have, keep to yourself before God. Blessed is the one who does not judge himself in what he approves.

verses.text: But the one who doubts, if he eats, has been condemned, because it is not from faith; and everything that is not from faith is sin.
verses.display_text: But the one who doubts, if he eats, has been condemned, because it is not from faith; and everything that is not from faith is sin.

verses.text: And we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of those without strength, and not to please ourselves.
verses.display_text: And we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of those without strength, and not to please ourselves.

verses.text: Let each of us please our neighbor for his good, to build him up.
verses.display_text: Let each of us please our neighbor for his good, to build him up.

verses.text: For even Christ did not please Himself; but just as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproach Thee fell upon Me.”
verses.display_text: For even Christ did not please Himself; but just as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproach Thee fell upon Me.”

verses.text: For whatever was written beforehand was written for our instruction, so that through perseverance and through the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
verses.display_text: For whatever was written beforehand was written for our instruction, so that through perseverance and through the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

verses.text: And may the God of perseverance and encouragement grant you to have the same mind among one another according to Christ Jesus,
verses.display_text: And may the God of perseverance and encouragement grant you to have the same mind among one another according to Christ Jesus,

verses.text: so that with one accord and one mouth you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.display_text: so that with one accord and one mouth you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.text: Therefore welcome one another, just as Christ also welcomed you, to God’s glory.
verses.display_text: Therefore welcome one another, just as Christ also welcomed you, to God’s glory.

verses.text: For I say that Christ has become a servant of the circumcision for God’s truth, to confirm the promises of the fathers,
verses.display_text: For I say that Christ has become a servant of the circumcision for God’s truth, to confirm the promises of the fathers,

verses.text: and for the Gentiles to glorify God for mercy, just as it is written, “For this reason I will give thanks to Thee among the Gentiles, and sing praise to Thy name.”
verses.display_text: and for the Gentiles to glorify God for mercy, just as it is written, “For this reason I will give thanks to Thee among the Gentiles, and sing praise to Thy name.”

verses.text: And again it says, “Rejoice, Gentiles, with His people.”
verses.display_text: And again it says, “Rejoice, Gentiles, with His people.”

verses.text: And again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles, and let all the peoples praise Him.”
verses.display_text: And again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles, and let all the peoples praise Him.”

verses.text: And again Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, and the One who rises to rule Gentiles; upon Him Gentiles will hope.”
verses.display_text: And again Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, and the One who rises to rule Gentiles; upon Him Gentiles will hope.”

verses.text: And may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, so that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
verses.display_text: And may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, so that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.

verses.text: And I myself am convinced about you, my brothers, that you yourselves also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
verses.display_text: And I myself am convinced about you, my brothers, that you yourselves also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

verses.text: But I wrote more boldly to you on some points, to remind you again, because of the grace given me by God
verses.display_text: But I wrote more boldly to you on some points, to remind you again, because of the grace given me by God

verses.text: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, performing priestly service with God’s gospel, so that the offering of the Gentiles may become acceptable, sanctified in the Holy Spirit.
verses.display_text: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, performing priestly service with God’s gospel, so that the offering of the Gentiles may become acceptable, sanctified in the Holy Spirit.

verses.text: Therefore I have reason to boast in Christ Jesus concerning the things of God;
verses.display_text: Therefore I have reason to boast in Christ Jesus concerning the things of God;

verses.text: for I will not dare to speak of anything that Christ did not work through me for the Gentiles’ obedience, in word and deed,
verses.display_text: for I will not dare to speak of anything that Christ did not work through me for the Gentiles’ obedience, in word and deed,

verses.text: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of the Spirit of God, so that from Jerusalem and around as far as Illyricum I have fulfilled the proclamation of Christ’s gospel,
verses.display_text: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of the Spirit of God, so that from Jerusalem and around as far as Illyricum I have fulfilled the proclamation of Christ’s gospel,

verses.text: and so making it my ambition to proclaim the gospel where Christ has not been named, so that I would not build on another’s foundation,
verses.display_text: and so making it my ambition to proclaim the gospel where Christ has not been named, so that I would not build on another’s foundation,

verses.text: but just as it is written, “Those to whom nothing about Him was announced will see, and those who have not heard will understand.”
verses.display_text: but just as it is written, “Those to whom nothing about Him was announced will see, and those who have not heard will understand.”

verses.text: For this reason I was also often hindered from coming to you;
verses.display_text: For this reason I was also often hindered from coming to you;

verses.text: but now, no longer having a place in these regions, and having a longing for many years to come to you,
verses.display_text: but now, no longer having a place in these regions, and having a longing for many years to come to you,

verses.text: whenever I travel to Spain—for I hope to see you as I pass through, and to be sent onward there by you, if I may first be filled in some measure by your company—
verses.display_text: whenever I travel to Spain—for I hope to see you as I pass through, and to be sent onward there by you, if I may first be filled in some measure by your company—

verses.text: but now I am traveling to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
verses.display_text: but now I am traveling to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

verses.text: For Macedonia and Achaia were pleased to make a contribution for the poor among the saints in Jerusalem.
verses.display_text: For Macedonia and Achaia were pleased to make a contribution for the poor among the saints in Jerusalem.

verses.text: For they were pleased, and they are their debtors; for if the Gentiles shared in their spiritual things, they also owe them service in material things.
verses.display_text: For they were pleased, and they are their debtors; for if the Gentiles shared in their spiritual things, they also owe them service in material things.

verses.text: Therefore, having completed this and sealed this fruit for them, I will depart by way of you for Spain.
verses.display_text: Therefore, having completed this and sealed this fruit for them, I will depart by way of you for Spain.

verses.text: And I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of Christ’s blessing.
verses.display_text: And I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of Christ’s blessing.

verses.text: And I urge you, brothers, through our Lord Jesus Christ and through the love of the Spirit, to struggle together with me in prayers to God for me,
verses.display_text: And I urge you, brothers, through our Lord Jesus Christ and through the love of the Spirit, to struggle together with me in prayers to God for me,

verses.text: so that I may be rescued from those who disobey in Judea, and my service for Jerusalem may become acceptable to the saints,
verses.display_text: so that I may be rescued from those who disobey in Judea, and my service for Jerusalem may become acceptable to the saints,

verses.text: so that, coming to you in joy through God’s will, I may find rest together with you.
verses.display_text: so that, coming to you in joy through God’s will, I may find rest together with you.

verses.text: And may the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
verses.display_text: And may the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

verses.text: And I commend to you Phoebe our sister, who is also a deacon of the Church in Cenchreae,
verses.display_text: And I commend to you Phoebe our sister, who is also a deacon of the Church in Cenchreae,

verses.text: so that you may welcome her in the Lord in a manner worthy of the saints, and stand by her in whatever matter she may need from you; for she herself has been a patron of many, and of me personally.
verses.display_text: so that you may welcome her in the Lord in a manner worthy of the saints, and stand by her in whatever matter she may need from you; for she herself has been a patron of many, and of me personally.

verses.text: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
verses.display_text: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

verses.text: who risked their own neck for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the Churches of the Gentiles;
verses.display_text: who risked their own neck for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the Churches of the Gentiles;

verses.text: and greet the Church in their house. Greet Epaenetus my beloved, who is the firstfruits of Asia for Christ.
verses.display_text: and greet the Church in their house. Greet Epaenetus my beloved, who is the firstfruits of Asia for Christ.

verses.text: Greet Mary, who labored much for you.
verses.display_text: Greet Mary, who labored much for you.

verses.text: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen and fellow prisoners, who are distinguished among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
verses.display_text: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen and fellow prisoners, who are distinguished among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

verses.text: Greet Ampliatus, my beloved in the Lord.
verses.display_text: Greet Ampliatus, my beloved in the Lord.

verses.text: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
verses.display_text: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

verses.text: Greet Apelles, approved in Christ. Greet those of Aristobulus’s household.
verses.display_text: Greet Apelles, approved in Christ. Greet those of Aristobulus’s household.

verses.text: Greet Herodion my kinsman. Greet those of Narcissus’s household who are in the Lord.
verses.display_text: Greet Herodion my kinsman. Greet those of Narcissus’s household who are in the Lord.

verses.text: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.
verses.display_text: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

verses.text: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
verses.display_text: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

verses.text: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers with them.
verses.display_text: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers with them.

verses.text: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas and all the saints with them.
verses.display_text: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas and all the saints with them.

verses.text: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the Churches of Christ greet you.
verses.display_text: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the Churches of Christ greet you.

verses.text: And I urge you, brothers, to watch those who cause divisions and snares contrary to the teaching you learned, and turn away from them;
verses.display_text: And I urge you, brothers, to watch those who cause divisions and snares contrary to the teaching you learned, and turn away from them;

verses.text: for such people do not serve our Lord Christ, but their own belly, and through smooth speech and flattery they deceive the hearts of the unsuspecting.
verses.display_text: for such people do not serve our Lord Christ, but their own belly, and through smooth speech and flattery they deceive the hearts of the unsuspecting.

verses.text: For your obedience has reached everyone; therefore I rejoice over you, but I want you to be wise about what is good and innocent about what is evil.
verses.display_text: For your obedience has reached everyone; therefore I rejoice over you, but I want you to be wise about what is good and innocent about what is evil.

verses.text: And the God of peace will crush Satan under your feet soon. The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.
verses.display_text: And the God of peace will crush Satan under your feet soon. The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.

verses.text: Timothy my fellow worker greets you, and Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my kinsmen.
verses.display_text: Timothy my fellow worker greets you, and Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my kinsmen.

verses.text: I, Tertius, who wrote the letter, greet you in the Lord.
verses.display_text: I, Tertius, who wrote the letter, greet you in the Lord.

verses.text: Gaius, my host and host of the whole Church, greets you. Erastus the city steward greets you, and Quartus the brother.
verses.display_text: Gaius, my host and host of the whole Church, greets you. Erastus the city steward greets you, and Quartus the brother.

verses.text: [[The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.]]
verses.display_text: [[The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.]]

verses.text: [Now to the One able to strengthen you according to my gospel and the proclamation of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of a mystery kept silent through long ages,
verses.display_text: [Now to the One able to strengthen you according to my gospel and the proclamation of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of a mystery kept silent through long ages,

verses.text: but now revealed, and through prophetic writings, according to the command of the eternal God, made known to all the nations for the obedience of faith,
verses.display_text: but now revealed, and through prophetic writings, according to the command of the eternal God, made known to all the nations for the obedience of faith,

verses.text: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory throughout the ages. Amen.]
verses.display_text: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory throughout the ages. Amen.]
